name: Vienna University of Economics and Business
summary: Vienna's public business and economics university; one bachelor's in English, Business and Economics (BBE), 240 places in 2026 via an entrance exam.

ib.text: A passed IB Diploma; beyond languages, WU sets no subject combination or minimum grades. Every bachelor's needs its selection procedure; the German ones need German C1 (German A HL 6, A SL 7 or B HL 7).

programmes.name: Business and Economics (BBE)
programmes.about: Foundations of business and economics with social and legal perspectives, applied in projects, then a choice among more than 30 business, economics and law specialisations, with a class that is 60% international.
programmes.ib: No German needed; English B2. An unscored online self-assessment, then a written exam in Vienna on English, maths and business basics.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published. A 2-hour multiple-choice exam in Vienna (English, maths, business and economics reading); the top 240 are admitted.

notes: The BBE selection runs once a year in spring, before IB results; details of the 2027/28 procedure are due in mid-November 2026.
You can register for the selection in your final school year and show your school certificate only at admission, from July.
A pass in the selection is valid only for the winter semester straight after it, so you cannot defer.
